note: Invented clean notes measured once each and never used to tune: batch1 was written after the in-sample tuning (it then informed the move to the larger SCOWL list); batch2 was written after that move. Reported, not gated.

batch1.symptoms: Swelling of both feet for 10 days, worse by evening. Mild breathlessness on walking.
batch1.examination: Pitting oedema up to mid-shin. Jugular venous pressure raised. Bilateral basal crepitations.
batch1.plan: Echocardiogram, renal function and electrolytes ordered.
batch1.advice: Weigh yourself every morning. Limit salt in food.
batch1.follow_up: Return at once if breathlessness at rest.

batch1.symptoms: Recurrent mouth ulcers for 3 months. Painful while eating spicy food.
batch1.examination: Two shallow aphthous ulcers on the inner lip. No lymph nodes felt.
batch1.plan: Blood count and vitamin B12 level ordered.
batch1.advice: Avoid very spicy and sour food. Use a soft toothbrush.

batch1.symptoms: Heel pain on first steps in the morning for 2 months.
batch1.examination: Tenderness at the medial heel. Tight calf muscles.
batch1.advice: Wear cushioned footwear. Roll the foot over a cold bottle.

batch1.symptoms: Scaly itchy patches on the elbows and scalp for a year.
batch1.examination: Well demarcated silvery plaques on both elbows. Nail pitting.
batch1.advice: Keep the skin moisturised. Avoid scratching.

batch1.symptoms: Snoring and daytime sleepiness for 6 months. Wakes up with a dry mouth.
batch1.advice: Avoid alcohol in the evening. Sleep on your side.
batch1.follow_up: Review with the sleep study report.

batch1.symptoms: Painful swelling in the groin on the right side when coughing for 1 month.
batch1.examination: Reducible right inguinal swelling with a cough impulse.
batch1.follow_up: Go to the emergency department at once if the swelling becomes hard and painful and does not go back.

batch1.symptoms: Tingling and numbness in the right thumb and index finger at night for 2 months.
batch1.examination: Positive Tinel sign at the right wrist. Grip normal.
batch1.plan: Nerve conduction study ordered. Wrist splint at night.
batch1.follow_up: Review with the nerve conduction report.

batch1.symptoms: Hair fall for 3 months after a febrile illness.
batch1.examination: Diffuse thinning. Pull test positive. Scalp normal.
batch1.advice: Eat a protein rich diet. Be gentle while combing.

batch1.symptoms: Child with barking cough and hoarse voice since last night. Mild fever.
batch1.examination: Inspiratory stridor only when crying. Chest clear.
batch1.plan: Supportive care explained to the parents.
batch1.advice: Keep the child calm. Offer fluids often.
batch1.follow_up: Return at once if the child struggles to breathe or the lips turn blue.

batch1.symptoms: Irregular periods and acne for a year. Weight gain.
batch1.examination: Acne on the face. Excess hair on the chin. BMI 31.
batch1.plan: Pelvic ultrasound and hormone profile ordered.
batch1.advice: Regular exercise and a balanced diet.

batch2.symptoms: Burning feet and numbness in both soles for 4 months, worse at night.
batch2.examination: Reduced vibration sense at both ankles. Ankle reflexes absent.
batch2.plan: Blood sugar, vitamin B12 and thyroid tests ordered.
batch2.advice: Check your feet daily for cuts. Wear soft footwear.

batch2.symptoms: Yellow eyes and dark urine for 1 week with loss of appetite.
batch2.examination: Scleral icterus. Liver palpable two fingers below the costal margin, tender.
batch2.plan: Liver function tests and hepatitis serology ordered.
batch2.advice: Avoid alcohol completely. Eat a light diet.
batch2.follow_up: Return at once if confused or very drowsy.

batch2.symptoms: Painful swelling under the right jaw while eating for 2 weeks.
batch2.examination: Tender swollen right submandibular gland. Dry mouth.
batch2.advice: Suck on lemon drops sparingly and drink plenty of water.

batch2.symptoms: Recurrent nosebleeds from the left side for 2 weeks.
batch2.examination: Prominent vessels on the left anterior septum. Blood pressure 132/84.
batch2.advice: Pinch the soft part of the nose for ten minutes if it bleeds. Avoid picking the nose.
batch2.follow_up: Go to the emergency department if bleeding does not stop after twenty minutes.

batch2.symptoms: Pain at the outer elbow on gripping for 6 weeks.
batch2.examination: Tenderness over the lateral epicondyle. Pain on resisted wrist extension.
batch2.plan: Activity modification and a forearm strap.
batch2.advice: Rest the arm from gripping tasks.

batch2.symptoms: Palpitations off and on for 1 month, lasting a few minutes. No fainting.
batch2.examination: Pulse regular, 96 per minute. Fine tremor of the hands.
batch2.plan: Thyroid function tests and ECG ordered.
batch2.advice: Cut down on tea and coffee.
batch2.follow_up: Return at once if chest pain or fainting.

batch2.symptoms: Itchy scalp with white flakes for 3 months.
batch2.examination: Greasy scales over the scalp and eyebrows.
batch2.advice: Wash the hair regularly. Avoid oily hair products.

batch2.symptoms: Pain in the right lower abdomen since this morning with nausea and loss of appetite.
batch2.examination: Tenderness and guarding in the right iliac fossa. Rebound tenderness.
batch2.advice: Do not eat or drink until the surgeon sees you.
batch2.follow_up: Go to the emergency department now.

batch2.symptoms: Forgetfulness for 1 year noticed by the family. Gets lost in familiar places.
batch2.examination: Mini mental state score 21 out of 30. Gait normal.
batch2.plan: Neurology referral and blood tests ordered.
batch2.advice: Keep a daily routine and a written diary.

batch2.symptoms: Child with a limp for 2 days after a fall. No fever.
batch2.examination: Pain on rotating the left hip. Able to stand.
batch2.diagnosis: Suspected transient synovitis of the left hip
batch2.advice: Rest and avoid running for a week.
batch2.follow_up: Return at once if fever develops or the child cannot stand.
